content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Bitcoin ebook

When considering how to accept Bitcoin for ebook sales, the options you have dictate not just your payment processing, but your overall business model. Platforms like Gumroad offer convenience but come with steep fees, charging 10% on every sale. In contrast, using a sovereign stack with NOWPayments allows for accepting Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies with only a 0.5% fee. This means you keep more of your earnings—an essential factor for any creator. The architecture of your chosen solution matters significantly; with the right infrastructure, you gain autonomy over your sales and payment processing.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

For creators in countries where traditional payment processors are not an option, like Nigeria or Venezuela, the choice of payment infrastructure becomes critical. While platforms like Gumroad are largely inaccessible in these regions, a sovereign commerce stack built with tools like Cloudflare and NOWPayments provides a viable alternative. This architecture allows you to navigate around the restrictions imposed by conventional payment platforms, giving you the flexibility to sell directly to your audience without being hindered by geographical limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Understanding the payment speed and fees associated with each option is vital for your bottom line. Gumroad’s 10% fee per sale quickly adds up, especially in high-volume scenarios. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 ebook, you would lose $970 to fees. In contrast, using NOWPayments would only cost you $46.50 in fees, retaining $921 more for your business. The speed of payment confirmation also matters; NOWPayments ensures quick transaction validation, allowing you to deliver your ebooks to customers almost instantly.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% compared to Gumroad's 10%.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of your infrastructure is a non-negotiable element for sustainable success. With conventional platforms, you often relinquish control over customer data and payment processing. However, a sovereign stack allows you to maintain full ownership, providing peace of mind and long-term viability. Automation is also a key feature of this infrastructure, enabling seamless delivery of ebooks via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This means that once a payment is confirmed, customers receive their products automatically, enhancing the user experience and reducing the workload on your end.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Deciding on the right architecture for accepting Bitcoin hinges on your specific needs and circumstances. If you’re looking for a quick setup with minimal upfront costs, a solution like the Sovereign Starter Stack may be ideal. However, for those needing more robust features and scalability, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all necessary blueprints and templates to build and deploy a complete digital commerce stack. Analyze your sales volume, expected growth, and the technical capabilities you possess to choose the architecture that best fits your situation.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Full ownership of your sales infrastructure means no restrictions.

This kit equips you with all the tools and templates necessary to build and scale your digital commerce stack effectively. Check out https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify your ebook and set a price. Choose the sovereign commerce stack that best fits your needs. Set up your website using Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages for hosting. Integrate NOWPayments for accepting Bitcoin with minimal fees. Configure automated delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Test the entire process to ensure seamless transactions. Launch your ebook sales platform and promote it to your audience.

By using automated delivery systems with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can ensure that your digital products are delivered instantly upon payment confirmation.
